title: Crispy American Chicken Sandwich
description: A classic American sandwich filled with crispy chicken, crunchy lettuce, juicy tomato, and creamy mayonnaise.
instructions: 1. Cut the chicken breast into thin cutlets.
2. In a shallow dish, mix together flour and a pinch of salt.
3. Dip each chicken cutlet into the flour mixture, then into the beaten egg, and finally into the breadcrumbs.
4. Heat about 1/2 inch of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
5. Fry the chicken cutlets until golden brown and cooked through, about 4-5 minutes per side.
7. Assemble the sandwiches by spreading mayonnaise on the bottom bun, followed by a chicken cutlet, a lettuce leaf, a tomato slice, an American cheese slice, and finally the top bun.
